title: Bound retries and reconnect loops
description: Ensure reconnect/respawn behavior has bounded intervals, explicit terminal failure, and observable retry state for every process backend.
acceptanceCriteria: No retry path can spin in a tight loop or schedule unbounded duplicate timers
Retry delay is finite, configurable only through an allowlisted setting, and includes a terminal failure path or bounded backoff policy
A stop/dispose cancels pending retries and prevents respawn after intentional shutdown
Tests cover rapid failure, repeated failure, stop during backoff, and successful recovery

steps.description: Use fake timers or an injectable clock/scheduler to expose duplicate timers and unbounded delays without waiting in real time.

steps.details: Read `packages/tunnel-core/src/process.ts` and config builders, then document each timer/respawn path and its ownership/cancellation point.
Apply the smallest shared fix for child and systemd paths, preserving intentional autossh behavior and public API compatibility.
Run retry tests plus the existing custom harness and typecheck.

technicalNotes: Do not arbitrarily remove reconnect behavior; the goal is bounded, observable recovery rather than a single attempt.
